about: How a scene's first line says what happened (the fact `happened`), by which fact of the cause record (causeRecordFacts, src/director/cause-facts.ts) names it. Only the bill by its name is here: a law by its name, 'the law on {topic}' and 'the {offense} charge' come back each with a played first line (Words lead, Nov 15). A cause record with none of these names no happening, and its scene opens on the plain first line. Read by happenedSaid in src/english/happened-words.ts.
